notes.title: Major Update: New Classes, TDM, Proximity Chat & More!
notes.content:
🛠️ The Battle Clash Expansion Update is Here!

🔥 What’s New?
✅ New Classes – Play as the Farmer and Miner, each with unique abilities!
✅ Team Deathmatch Mode – Squad up, strategize, and dominate!
✅ Class Choose Mode – Pick your favorite class instead of random selection!
✅ Proximity Chat – Communicate (or deceive) based on distance!
✅ Steam Achievements – Challenge yourself and unlock rewards!
And more... to be revealed

⚡ Major Fixes & Improvements
🔹 Fixed "moon physics" & general movement speed buff
🔹 Crosshair now turns red when aiming at an enemy
🔹 Fixed ladder glitch & delayed projectile firing
🔹 Reworked lobby system for smoother multiplayer
🔹 Optimized performance for a better experience

⚔️ See you in battle!
